description: Test jsonb_each in select-list position (PostgreSQL SRF-in-target-list): the result is a single anonymous record column, not text

columns.name: kv
columns.note: jsonb_each in select-list position yields an anonymous (key, value) record, which the neutral type vocabulary cannot name -- unknown, not string

name: jsonb_each_select_list
query_sql:
-- @name GetDocEntries
-- @returns :many
SELECT id, jsonb_each(data) AS kv FROM documents
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE documents (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, data JSONB NOT NULL, metadata JSONB);
